description: This file implements the AI logic for choosing the movement direction of ghosts in a Pac-Man game. The AI prefers directions that reduce the Manhattan distance to Pac-Man when not powered and increase it when powered, avoiding reversing direction unless no alternative exists.

methods.name: chooseGhostDirection(maze, ghost, pacman, powered)
methods.description: Determines the next movement direction for a ghost based on current game state and simple AI logic, factoring in whether the ghost or Pac-Man is powered and avoiding reversing direction where possible.
